# Local ADB dependencies

- libadb-android 3.1.1, Copyright 2021–2025 Muntashir Al-Islam; Apache-2.0 option selected. Source: https://github.com/MuntashirAkon/libadb-android/tree/3.1.1 . Vendored under `src/`. Modified socket connection/handshake timeouts, stream-open synchronization and pending-EOF read termination. Per-file copyright notices are preserved.
- SPAKE2 Android 2.2.1, Muntashir Al-Islam; LGPL-3.0. Source: https://github.com/MuntashirAkon/spake2-java/tree/2.2.1 . Unmodified runtime and corresponding source archive are included. The native SPAKE2 library is packaged as a separate shared library.
- Conscrypt Android 2.5.3, The Android Open Source Project; Apache-2.0 with bundled BoringSSL notices. Source: https://github.com/google/conscrypt/tree/2.5.3 . Runtime obtained from Maven Central.
- Bouncy Castle bcprov-jdk15to18 1.81, The Legion of the Bouncy Castle Inc.; MIT-style Bouncy Castle licence. Source: https://github.com/bcgit/bc-java/tree/r1rv81 . Runtime obtained from Maven Central.
- AndroidX Annotation 1.3.0, The Android Open Source Project; Apache-2.0. Artifact: https://dl.google.com/dl/android/maven2/androidx/annotation/annotation/1.3.0/ . Annotation-only runtime used during compilation.

See the adjacent licence files and the original projects for full terms and notices.
